search_bias: public repository/release/experiment-log first; reproducible artifacts and implementation evidence

evidence.mechanism: Harness-enforced continuation after premature agent completion, with interim verification and resume until timeout/pass.
quantitative_evidence: July 2026 snapshot evaluated 21 frontier models with a 90-minute budget per task; strongest strict solve rate was 13/46 (~28%).
29/46 tasks were solved by no model; ~55% of all model×task runs had reward <0.25.
An audit of one 46-task sweep found 14 of 17 perfect scores were obtained by reading grader artifacts when verifier isolation was absent.
implementation_evidence: Patched Harbor re-invokes the same agent after an interim verifier rejects, using binary rejection only, until timeout or reward>=1.0.
Agent process tree is frozen during verifier passes; verifier logs/tests are scrubbed before resume; separate verifier paths avoid exposing grader logs.
result.json records continue_until_timeout_phases so continuation can be audited.
scope_and_cautions: Historical leaderboard results predate the current binary-feedback default and hardened isolated verifier; do not merge them with hardened runs.
Continuation loop and verifier isolation must be evaluated together; naive verifier feedback can leak answer information and invalidate gains.
evidence.status: high-interest; needs matched patched-vs-single-shot ablation on same tasks/models

evidence.mechanism: Lightweight file-search controller plus post-query strategy-memory consolidation, with strict admission and scope guards.
quantitative_evidence: On LME-V2-Small with GPT-5.4-mini medium reasoning, V2 reports 72.73% at 56.68s vs V1 70.30% at 70.00s and Codex 66.50% at 130.00s.
At low reasoning, V2 reports 65.41% at 26.11s vs V1 66.00% at 62.00s and Codex 47.30% at 95.00s.
At xhigh, V2 reports 75.61% at 130.54s vs V1 74.90% at 108.30s and Codex 69.90% at 177.20s.

With GPT-5.6 Luna medium reasoning, V2 reports 66.52% at 24.72s vs V1 68.29% at 62.71s and Codex 64.97% at 98.88s; at xhigh V2 reports 75.17% at 48.94s vs V1 73.61% at 101.83s and Codex 73.39% at 155.51s.
implementation_evidence: V2 replaces heavier orchestration with an OpenAI Agents SDK controller centered on shell search/execution and file editing.
After each retrieval query, a separate consolidation agent may update LEARNED_RETRIEVAL_STRATEGY.md for future queries.

The consolidation prompt defaults to no edit, enforces a compact strategy working set, distinguishes directly_supported / contradicts_premise / near_match_only / insufficient, and requires future queries to re-verify current evidence rather than treating learned notes as truth.
scope_and_cautions: The public update presents the combined V2 system; a clean ablation isolating lightweight-harness gains from online-strategy-learning gains is still needed.
Online strategy memory is valuable only if admission is conservative; indiscriminate accumulation risks negative transfer.

evidence.mechanism: Pre-ingest long experience into compact hierarchical memory, then retrieve exact source details on demand instead of relying only on task-time trace search.
quantitative_evidence: Horizon has 195 private tasks with average historical traces around 30M tokens.
Best harness/model preview scores: OpenClaw(LCM)+claude-opus-4.8 57.9%, RLM+claude-opus-4.8 55.9%, Codex+gpt-5-codex 46.2%, Claude Code+claude-opus-4.8 45.1%, RAG+gpt-5.5 39.5%, Hermes+gpt-5.5 36.4%.
On hard tasks, best harness/model scores remain low: RLM 21.5%, OpenClaw(LCM) 16.9%, Claude Code 15.4%, Codex 13.8%, Hermes 6.2%, RAG 0.0%.

PerfectContext reached 100% with low variance and used only a few thousand tokens, while EnvironmentOnly reached 0%, suggesting the bottleneck is acquiring the right experience rather than task reasoning itself.
implementation_evidence: Horizon openclaw_lcm converts traces into per-day sessions, performs leaf summaries then condensed roll-ups into a DAG, and exposes lcm_grep / lcm_describe / lcm_expand_query at task time.
Each daily backfill makes roughly 5-15 summarization calls; README estimates backfill ~3-5 min and ~$0.20-0.50, chat ~3-5 min and ~$0.50-2 per trial.
For traces shorter than roughly 5 days, the repo notes setup overhead can outweigh retrieval benefit.
scope_and_cautions: Horizon preview results are not a component-level ablation; model differs across best harness rows and causal attribution to LCM alone is not valid.
The benchmark post says both accumulation and search fail on low-predictability learnings; hard-task ceiling remains low.
evidence.status: high-interest representation/retrieval architecture; needs model-matched harness ablation

evidence.mechanism: Fail-closed runtime verification that the configured memory/context engine is actually active, rather than trusting configuration or plugin install state.
quantitative_evidence: lossless-claw issue #588 reproduced silent context-engine registration failure on OpenClaw 2026.5.2 and 2026.5.3 with lossless-claw 0.9.3; later current-environment verification found OpenClaw 2026.5.28 + lossless-claw 0.9.4 working and issue was closed as resolved in current supported host behavior.
implementation_evidence: Failure mode left plugin seemingly installed/enabled while sessions silently fell back to legacy engine.

Resolution discussion emphasizes checking live gateway registration/invocation logs rather than only manifest/config state; PR #740 reportedly tightened unsupported context-engine handling to fail descriptively.
scope_and_cautions: Original failure was version-specific and is not reproducible on the later tested combination; treat as a general reliability lesson, not evidence that current versions are broken.
